Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A connecting device (6) is provided for interconnecting a windscreen wiper device (1) of the flat blade type and an oscillating arm (7) pivotally connectable to the connecting device about a pivot axis near one end thereof. The windscreen wiper device includes an elastic, elongated carrier element, as well as an elongated wiper blade (2) of a flexible material, which can be placed in abutment with a windscreen to be wiped. The wiper blade includes at least one groove (3), in which groove a longitudinal strip (4) of the carrier element is disposed. The connecting device is arranged to be connected to the longitudinal strip, and includes—at least one hole (19) of a first type arranged to allow a welding tool access through the hole of the first type to contact the longitudinal strip for welding the longitudinal strip and the connecting device together; and—at least one hole (20) of a second type arranged to allow a pin access through the hole of the second type and through the longitudinal strip for interconnecting the longitudinal strip and the connecting device.

A connector (6) is designed to couple a flat-blade windscreen wiper assembly (1) to an oscillating arm (7). Near one end of the arm, the arm is pivotally attachable to the connector about a pivot axis. The wiper assembly comprises an elongated, resilient carrier element and a flexible, elongated wiper blade (2) configured to bear against a windscreen during wiping. At least one groove (3) is formed in the wiper blade and accommodates a longitudinal strip (4) belonging to the carrier element.

The connector is configured for attachment to the longitudinal strip and comprises:

- at least one first-type opening (19) through which a welding tool can reach and contact the longitudinal strip, enabling the strip to be welded to the connector; and  
- at least one second-type opening (20) that permits a pin to pass through both the opening and the longitudinal strip, thereby securing the strip and the connector to one another.
outputs.L3:
The connecting device is configured to couple a flat-blade windscreen wiper device to an oscillating arm that pivots near one end of the wiper device. The wiper device comprises an elastic, elongated carrier element and a flexible, elongated wiper blade designed to contact and wipe the windscreen. The wiper blade includes at least one longitudinal groove in which a longitudinal strip of the carrier element is received.

The connecting device further includes a first type of hole that provides access for a welding tool, enabling the longitudinal strip to be welded to the connecting device. A second type of hole is configured to receive a pin extending through both the connecting device and the longitudinal strip, thereby mechanically interconnecting the two components.
outputs.L4:
A connecting device is provided for coupling a flat-blade windscreen wiper to a pivoting oscillating wiper arm. The flat-blade wiper includes an elongated wiping element supported by a longitudinal carrier strip that provides the flexibility and resilient contact pressure required for the wiper to follow the curvature of a windscreen. The connecting device is positioned on the carrier strip and forms an interface between the wiper blade and the end of the oscillating arm, allowing the blade to pivot during operation while remaining securely attached.

To facilitate attachment, the connecting device and the carrier strip are provided with dedicated access holes. These openings permit welding equipment to reach selected joining regions so that the device can be fixed directly to the carrier strip by one or more welded connections. The holes may also be aligned to receive fastening pins, enabling the device to be secured mechanically instead of, or in addition to, being welded. Proper alignment of the access holes helps locate the connecting device accurately on the carrier strip and ensures that loads generated during wiping are transferred reliably between the arm, the connector, and the blade.

The availability of both welded and pinned fastening options gives manufacturers greater flexibility when selecting an assembly process. Welding can provide a compact and permanent joint without requiring separate fasteners, while pinning can simplify assembly, inspection, repair, or replacement and may be preferable where welding equipment or weld-compatible materials are not available. In some configurations, both methods may be used together to provide supplementary retention and increased resistance to loosening, displacement, or separation under repeated oscillation and changing environmental conditions.

Accordingly, the dual-connection arrangement supports efficient production while improving the strength and reliability of the interconnection. By integrating the required access and alignment features into the connecting device and carrier strip, the design can reduce assembly complexity, promote consistent positioning, and accommodate different materials, manufacturing methods, and service requirements.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a connecting device that joins a flat-blade windscreen wiper to an oscillating arm, using separate holes for welding access and pin fastening.
counterfactuals.output: A connecting device for coupling a flat-blade windscreen wiper to an oscillating wiper arm comprises a connector body secured to a supporting structure of the wiper blade and configured to receive an end portion of the oscillating arm. The connector body includes a welding-access hole through which a welding operation is performed to secure the connector body to the supporting structure, and a separate fastening hole configured to receive a pin for pivotally fastening the oscillating arm to the connector body. By providing distinct holes for welding access and pin fastening, the device facilitates assembly, preserves the integrity of the fastening region, and provides a compact and reliable connection between the wiper blade and the oscillating arm.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention for interconnecting a flexible wiper blade’s longitudinal carrier strip with a pivotable wiper arm, including both welded and pinned connection options.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention provides a compact connector between a flexible wiper blade and a wiper arm. The blade has at least one longitudinal, spring-elastic carrier strip that distributes the arm’s contact force along the wiping element. A connecting member is mounted near the center of the strip and includes upstanding cheeks or bearing portions defining a transverse pivot axis. An end piece or adapter of the wiper arm fits between or around these portions and pivots about a shaft, pin, or trunnions, allowing the blade to follow windshield curvature.

Two ways of fixing the connecting member to the carrier strip are contemplated:

- **Welded version:** A base plate, feet, or lateral tabs of the connecting member lie against the carrier strip and are secured by spot, projection, resistance, or laser welds. The welds are spaced along the strip to spread operating loads while leaving most of the carrier free to flex.
- **Pinned version:** The connecting member and carrier strip have aligned openings through which one or more rivets, roll pins, or headed fastening pins are inserted. The pins may be staked, riveted, clipped, or otherwise retained. A separate transverse pin normally forms the pivot joint with the wiper arm, although an integrated pin arrangement may perform both locating and articulation functions.

In either embodiment, the connector transfers pressing, pulling, and reversal forces from the pivotable arm directly into the resilient carrier strip, minimizes the number and height of components, and permits substantially the same connector geometry to be manufactured using either welding or mechanical pinning.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.output: A flat-blade windshield wiper assembly comprising a resilient carrier strip supporting a wiper blade and a connector secured to the carrier strip, the connector including a first hole configured to receive a welding tool for welding the connector to the carrier strip and a second hole configured to receive a pin extending through the connector and the carrier strip to mechanically couple the connector to the carrier strip.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a technical patent abstract based on these components: windscreen wiper device, elastic elongated carrier element, flexible grooved wiper blade, longitudinal strip, pivotable oscillating arm, welding-access hole, and pin-access hole.
counterfactuals.output: A windscreen wiper device comprises an elastic elongated carrier element and a flexible wiper blade having a longitudinal groove in which at least one longitudinal strip of the carrier element is received. The carrier element biases the wiper blade toward a curved configuration and distributes a wiping force along the blade during operation. A connecting device secured to the wiper blade is configured to pivotably couple the wiper blade to an oscillating arm about a pivot axis. The connecting device includes at least one welding-access hole aligned with a region at which the connecting device is welded to the longitudinal strip, thereby permitting formation or inspection of a weld through the welding-access hole. The connecting device further includes a pin-access hole aligned with a pivot pin or retaining pin of the oscillating arm to facilitate insertion, removal, or engagement of the pin. The arrangement provides a compact, serviceable coupling while maintaining reliable attachment of the carrier element, wiper blade, and oscillating arm.

counterfactuals.prompt: Explain in formal European patent language a connecting device for a flat-blade windscreen wiper in which the connector can be secured to the longitudinal strip by welding through one type of hole and by a pin through another type of hole.
counterfactuals.output:
A connecting device for connecting a wiper arm to a flat-blade windscreen-wiper assembly comprises a connector arranged to be mounted on at least one longitudinal supporting strip of the wiper blade. The connector is provided with first and second fastening apertures of mutually different configurations.

The first fastening apertures are arranged to expose respective portions of the longitudinal supporting strip and thereby permit the formation, through said first fastening apertures, of welded joints between the connector and the longitudinal supporting strip.

The second fastening aperture is arranged to receive a fastening pin extending through the connector and engaging, preferably passing through, a corresponding aperture formed in the longitudinal supporting strip, whereby relative displacement of the connector and the longitudinal supporting strip is prevented.

Accordingly, the connector is securable to the longitudinal supporting strip by welding through the first fastening apertures and/or by mechanical engagement of the fastening pin received in the second fastening aperture. The different fastening apertures thus permit the same connector configuration to be used with different fastening methods or with a combination thereof.
